subject: Hosted API: per-1M token pricing (input vs output) & model availability
messages:
From: Anna Torres <anna.torres@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Rachel,

Quick question — can you share Redwood's standard hosted API pricing per 1M tokens, specifically distinguishing input vs output token rates? We're comparing baseline costs across providers and need a clean bullet list for engineering. Also include the list of available hosted models (small/medium/large/gpt-class/embedding models) and whether EU-hosted instances are available.

To give context: we're evaluating chat summarization and embeddings for clinical notes. Likely volumes: on the order of a few hundred million tokens/month initially. We will also need SOC 2 and EU data residency.

Could you send the standard rate card and any notes on volume discounts / committed usage tiers?

Thanks,

Anna Torres
Director of AI Platforms
Brightleaf Health
[anna.torres@brightleafhealth.com]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <anna.torres@brightleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and context. See a quick baseline below (hosted API, per 1M tokens). This is our standard public list before discounts for committed volume or enterprise terms: 

- Small / fast models (suitable for short prompts, classification, some summarization): $0.40 per 1M input tokens / $0.80 per 1M output tokens
- Medium / multi-purpose models (general chat & generation): $1.50 per 1M input tokens / $3.00 per 1M output tokens
- Large / high-quality models (GPT-class, long-form generation): $3.75 per 1M input tokens / $7.50 per 1M output tokens
- Embeddings (text vectors) — billed per 1M tokens processed for embed generation: $1.20 per 1M tokens (note: embeddings are often measured by units returned; we bill by tokens for the hosted API)

A few important notes:
- Input vs output: we report and bill them separately — the invoice shows both lines so you can optimize prompts/lengths.
- Supported hosted models: small: rw-small-v1, medium: rw-medium-v1, large: rw-large-v1, gpt-class: rw-gptx-v1 (higher quality), embeddings: rw-embed-v1. We also offer quantized variants for lower-cost inference (ask if you want 4-bit/8-bit profiles).
- EU hosting: yes — we run hosted instances in eu-west-1 with data residency options on hosted accounts (SOC 2 in place; we can provide the audit report and data processing addendum).

I've attached our current public ratecard for reference and a short pricing notes PDF with common questions addressed. Can you confirm rough monthly token volumes (split input/output if you have that) and whether you prefer a 12-month committed commitment vs month-to-month? That'll help me model discounted tiers.

Attachment: [Redwood-hosted-ratecard-2026Q1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

Best,

Rachel Kim

Thanks, Rachel — that helps. A bit more color on volumes and constraints: 

- Expected steady-state (month 3+): ~150M input tokens / ~450M output tokens per month (chat-heavy summarization).
- We will also run periodic embedding batches: ~20M tokens/month for vector generation.
- Primary need: EU data residency and SOC 2. We will require documentation for procurement.
- Question on discounts: what typical % off list do you offer for a 12-month committed annual spend? Also curious whether you have a mid-tier committed plan (e.g., 1B tokens/month) with deeper discounts / reserved capacity (we have burst windows).

If you can sketch a couple of scenarios (month-to-month list vs 12-month commit at expected volumes vs 1B/month reserved), that would be great. Happy to schedule a short call next week to walk through.

Best,
Anna

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Anna — looping in Sean (Sales Lead) and Marcus (Pricing & Finance) to propose concrete scenarios. High-level sketches below — we can formalize in an MSA/quote once you confirm preferred term and region.

Scenario A — Month-to-month (list): billed at the public rates I sent earlier. No minimum commitment; flexible but no discounts.

Scenario B — 12-month committed (expected volumes: 150M in / 450M out + 20M embed):
- Standard offer: 15% off list across all hosted token lines for a 12-month commitment at your expected run-rate
- Reserved capacity: optional dedicated burst lane for calls during ET/CE windows (additional fee; discussion required)

Scenario C — Enterprise reserved (1B tokens/month committed):
- Tailored pricing: 25–35% off list depending on exact mix (more discount if majority of tokens are medium/large generation rather than embeddings)
- SLA-backed latency targets and options for Dedicated capacity in eu-west (if strict isolation required, this is a separate offering)

Notes:
- Overages: standard is billed at list rates for usage above committed tiers unless we agree to a blended overage price.
- EU data residency & compliance: SOC 2 Type II available; we will provide the cert and a standard DPA. EU-hosted endpoints are available for both hosted and Dedicated.

I've re-attached the ratecard here for procurement: [Redwood-hosted-ratecard-2026Q1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)].

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm preferred scenario (A/B/C) and whether you want a 12-month or 24-month term.
2) Share procurement contact and billing entity for contract routing.
3) If helpful, schedule a 30-minute call — I'm available Tue/Wed 09:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks — Sean and Marcus, any additional notes on how you typically handle blended overage pricing for a first-year enterprise commit?

Best,

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear volume guidance. Quick, actionable proposal to get procurement moving: 

- Offer: 12-month committed agreement at 20% off list (applies across input/output token lines) based on a baseline commitment of 600M tokens/month aggregated (your mix: 150M in / 450M out).
- Embeddings: included in the aggregate commit up to 20M tokens/month; additional embed usage billed at list*0.85.
- Overage: overages billed at 80% of list for the first 2 months while we scale capacity, then revert to list if sustained.
- EU data residency: we will provision eu-west-hosted endpoints and include SOC 2 Type II and a DPA in the contract.
- Next steps: please share the procurement contact and legal billing name; we'll draft a quote + MSA and circulate. We can also schedule a technical call with a solutions engineer to discuss dedicated burst lanes if needed.

If that looks OK I can have a preliminary quote out by EOD tomorrow.
